integrity: The proof verifies the biorthogonal Zak quotient, checks the zero and isotropic derivative of the Gaussian Zak transform, bounds the reciprocal-square error integrably, evaluates the angular Bessel average, obtains a universal additive error and transfers the estimate to every deleted atom by unitary lattice covariance. An independent numerical probe was used only to corroborate the exact argument.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to the critical square-lattice Gaussian Gabor system with exactly one atom deleted, using the unnormalized Gaussian. It proves a universal bounded-remainder logarithmic asymptotic and its leading constant but no additive limiting constant. The resulting explicit weight criterion is equivalent to the sufficient summability hypothesis in Zikkos, not asserted necessary for every weight making a lower semi-frame.
title: Sharp logarithmic asymptotics of critical Gaussian Gabor biorthogonals
